evals.prompt: Use this Google results page to investigate recurring complaints and reliable fixes discussed in public forums about [topic]. Cover every relevant forum represented on the first results page, cite canonical threads, and give me a report plus machine-readable evidence.
evals.expected_output: A provenance-aware Markdown report and community-evidence.json with a forum coverage ledger, verified claims, citations, contradictions, limits, and no snippet-only claims.
expectations: Enumerates distinct relevant forums and records exclusions or inaccessible sources
Separates search snippets from verified canonical thread evidence
Includes source URLs, retrieval dates, claim confidence, and limitations
Produces JSON that can be consumed by the research-heatmap skill

evals.prompt: Deep-research this query from the supplied Google SERP export. Some results are Reddit, a vendor community, and a private/login-only forum. Do not bypass access controls; tell me exactly what was verified and what remains unknown.
evals.expected_output: A graceful report that verifies accessible public sources, marks the private forum unverified, avoids treating snippets as proof, and explains coverage gaps.
expectations: Does not attempt login, CAPTCHA, paywall, or anti-bot bypass
Marks private or inaccessible sources as unverified with reasons
Includes a bounded scope and explicit evidence gaps

evals.prompt: Compare public community discussions across several forums about [product decision] during [date range]. Highlight disagreements and avoid claiming that the sample represents all users.
evals.expected_output: A time-bounded, citation-rich comparison with separate observed findings, corroboration, interpretation, contradictions, and sampling bias.
expectations: Applies the requested date range or labels missing dates
Surfaces contradictions instead of averaging them away
Avoids population-level claims unsupported by the search sample
